name: Eco City
summary:
Dive into a world of strategy and construction where every decision shapes your production network and the cities that depend on it!
Build factories, power plants, and purification stations, connect them with roads, and keep your resources in balance. Your goal is to produce goods, grow cities, and create efficient supply chains — all while keeping the environment clean. Each level brings new challenges and opportunities.

Basic buildings form the foundation of your economy. Mines extract stone, coal, ore, and oil, while sawmills produce wood. They only require energy and serve as the starting point for creating more advanced materials.

Factories are the heart of your production. They turn raw resources into refined materials — but be careful: factories consume energy, produce emissions, and demand careful planning.

Power plants supply energy to all your buildings. From coal plants to wind turbines, each type has its own cost and environmental impact. If consumption exceeds production, you’ll face an energy crisis!

Purification plants are your allies against pollution. They process emissions from factories and power plants — some even generate useful byproducts — but they also require energy. Keep pollution under control to prevent your cities from degrading.

Warehouses serve as logistics hubs. They store resources and help optimize delivery routes.

A key mechanic is city development. Each city offers unique trade deals — exchange resources for coins, upgrade cities to unlock new buildings, recipes, and materials. Higher-level cities demand more complex resources, but the rewards grow with them.

Connect every part of your infrastructure with three types of roads: dirt, city, and highway. Plan routes and expand your logistics network to keep production flowing smoothly.

Every new game generates a unique map full of resources and obstacles to navigate and exploit. Develop your industries, build supply chains, and watch your cities evolve into thriving metropolises!
